mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT's one-week improvement from -19.6 to -18.4 marks the start of a mobility recovery that propagates to discretionary trips; RETAIL_REC historically trails TRANSIT by roughly two weeks, so the next 28-day mean exceeds the last.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT weekly mean rose from -19.6 at t-1w to -18.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT continues to rise above -18.4 week-on-week while the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is lower than the last 28-day mean.

candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean stays at or above +7.0 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL recorded +7.0 at both t-1w and t-0w, its highest values in the window
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL remains at or above +7.0 for the next four weeks yet the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the last 28-day mean.

regime_hint: wet-season (tsuyu) onset with weather-driven outdoor suppression

failure_condition: TRANSIT crosses above -18.0 in a weekly mean and the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is still lower than the last 28-day mean.
